nights.title: Cem Belevi
nights.name: Cem Belevi
nights.extract: Cem Belevi is a Turkish pop singer, songwriter, and actor. He gained recognition for his collaborations, including the duet "Kim Ne Derse Desin" with Ayshe.

en.who: Cem Belevi is a turkish pop singer, songwriter and actor. he gained recognition for his collaborations.
facts: Cem Belevi is a Turkish pop singer, songwriter, and actor.
He gained recognition for his collaborations, including the duet "Kim Ne Derse Desin" with Ayshe.

facts: Cem Belevi ist ein türkischer popsänger, songwriter und schauspieler.

facts: Cem Belevi bir Türk pop şarkıcısı, söz yazarı ve oyuncudur.
Ayshe ile yaptığı "Kim Ne Derse Desin" düetiyle dahil iş birlikleriyle tanındı.
